facts.text: Undergraduate students at UW-Stevens Point receive course books through a textbook rental library system, with the rental fee included directly in tuition.

sources.title: Enrollment Appointment Times - Office of the Registrar

facts.text: UW-Stevens Point runs a textbook rental library: undergraduates check out most of their course books and return them at the end of the term.
